# Times Square NYC

> > Official guide to Times Square, featuring events, live entertainment, visitor information, and community services managed by the Times Square Alliance.

Times Square NYC serves as the comprehensive resource for one of the world's most iconic destinations, covering everything from New Year's Eve celebrations and live concerts at venues like Sony Hall, Town Hall, and Iridium, to practical visitor services including transportation, parking, and community outreach programs.

## Key Topics

- Times Square Alliance
- New Year's Eve
- TSQ Live
- Sony Hall
- Town Hall
- Iridium
- Live music and concerts
- Comedy shows
- Times Square events
- Visitor transportation and parking
- Community outreach services
- Brand partnerships and sponsorships
- Times Square entertainment district
- New York City attractions

## Visitor Information & Services

- [Getting Around & Parking](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/explore/getting-around-and-parking): Times Square parking, transit, subway, Citi Bike, and navigation guide
- [Outreach Services](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/times-square-alliance/outreach-services): Alliance outreach for homelessness, mental health via Fountain House

## New Year's Eve

- [NYE Media & Press](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/nye/nye-media-and-press): NYE media credentials, press releases, and broadcast coverage info

## Business & Partnerships

- [Partnerships & Sponsorships](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/business-community/partnerships-sponsorships): Brand partnerships and sponsorship opportunities in Times Square

## TSQ Live & Free Events

- [TSQ Live 2024 Summer Friday Concerts - BLÜ EYES](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/tsq-live-2024-summer-friday-concerts-blu-eyes): BLÜ EYES at TSQ Live 2024 free Friday summer concert series
- [TSQ Live with MTA Music - G Wyll](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/tsq-live-2024-live-music-with-mta-music-g-wyll): G Wyll MTA Music performance at TSQ Live near Wishing Wall

## Live Music & Concerts

- [Adrian Vandenberg](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/adrian-vandenberg): Adrian Vandenberg (Whitesnake) concert at Sony Hall in Times Square
- [Oz Noy, Chrissi Poland, Dave Weckl](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/oz-noy-chrissi-poland-dave-weckl): Oz Noy, Chrissi Poland, Dave Weckl jazz concert at Iridium March 2025
- [Roomful of Blues](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/roomful-of-blues): Roomful of Blues live performance at Iridium January 2025
- [Kalani Pe'a & Taimane](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/kalani-pea-taimane): Kalani Pe'a & Taimane Hawaiian music concert at Sony Hall NYE
- [On A Winter's Night](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/on-a-winters-night): On A Winter's Night folk reunion tour at Sony Hall with Gorka, Larkin
- [Alain Souchon](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/alain-souchon): Alain Souchon French chanson concert at The Town Hall
- [Lord of the Rings Concert](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/lord-of-the-rings-concert): Lords of the Sound orchestra performs Lord of the Rings at Town Hall
- [Coco in Concert](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/coco-in-concert): Disney Pixar's Coco live-to-film concert with The Sinfonietta

## Comedy & Entertainment

- [Dave Attell - NY Comedy Festival](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/nycf-dave-attell): Dave Attell stand-up comedy at Town Hall, NY Comedy Festival
- [Taskmaster Live on Stage](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/taskmaster-live-on-stage): Taskmaster Live comedy show at Town Hall January event
- [An Evening with Stephen Colbert and Evie McGee Colbert](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/an-evening-with-stephen-colbert-and-evie-mcgee-colbert): Stephen & Evie Colbert at Town Hall for Does This Taste Funny?
- [Off Night](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/off-night): Off Night monthly live variety show by Royal Family Productions

## Optional

- [Apollo's Mirror on Display](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/apollos-mirror-on-display-at-church-of-st-mary-the-virgin): Michael Petry's Apollo's Mirror art exhibition at St. Mary the Virgin
- [Redwood Talkback on Nature](https://www.timessquarenyc.org/events/redwood-talkback-on-nature): Redwood musical talkback with Julia Butterfly Hill at Nederlander
